text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Beijing Control, Singapore, 442, Boeing 777, fire in the rear toilet, descending 3600 metres, request emergency landing at Beijing Airport, position 50 miles west of Beijing, heading 060. Singapore, 442, Roger, Mayday. Break, break, all stations are 126.3, stop transmitting, Mayday. What is the position of Singapore 442?
